# ELEVOS (일레보스) — Managing Soccer

> ELEVOS is an independent Korean-language browser-based football management simulation by TRIPLE FROG GAMES. It combines fictional football club management, player card collection, enhancement, development, tactics, transfer markets and league/cup simulations. Full gameplay is designed for PC and tablet browsers; smartphones can access public informational pages.

ELEVOS is not affiliated with FIFA Online, FC Online or Football Manager. Beta features and balance may change; refer to the current game interface and official announcements for exact probabilities, rewards and eligibility. Public information is accessible without login; gameplay requires an account.

## Official information
- [Official website](https://elevos.co.kr/home): Game overview and entry.
- [Official FAQ](https://elevos.co.kr/faq.html): 34 direct answers about gameplay, supported devices, cards, tactics and club management.
- [Game overview](https://elevos.co.kr/about.html): Features and game systems.
- [Developer](https://elevos.co.kr/studio.html): Official development team information.
- [Game guide](https://elevos.co.kr/guide.html): Gameplay instructions.
- [Hall of fame](https://elevos.co.kr/hall.html): Fictional player collections and stories.

## System guides
- [Player enhancement](https://elevos.co.kr/player-enhancement.html): Card upgrades and rules.
- [Player development](https://elevos.co.kr/player-development.html): Player growth.

- [Transfer market](https://elevos.co.kr/transfer-market.html): Recruitment and squad planning.
- [Announcements](https://elevos.co.kr/notice.html): Current updates.
